name: ts-codemode
description: W4: 50 TypeScript code-mode turns. Turn 1 loads a 1 MB value into a session global and saves a function; every later turn awaits a lookup and a slow tool (each await parks the cell) with the 1 MB value live, and calls the saved function.

turns.user: Turn {turn}: load the corpus and keep it.

cell: const big = await tools.fixtureLarge({ key: "corpus", bytes: 1000000 });
const describe = (record, size) => record.title + " / " + size + " bytes kept";
await control.finish({ loaded: big.bytes, length: big.text.length });

turns.user: Turn {turn}: check item {turn} against the corpus.

cell: const waited = await tools.fixtureSlow({ key: "wait-{turn}", ms: 5 });
await control.finish({ turn: {turn}, last: last, head: head.length, waited: waited.waited_ms, score: record.score });
